# WinV for Linux

> Windows 11 style clipboard history (Win+V) and emoji picker (Win+.) for Ubuntu 22.04 / GNOME Shell 42, as a GNOME Shell extension. Open source (GPL-2.0-or-later).

- Super+V: clipboard history with text and images; click or Enter pastes into the previous app, pin, delete, clear all.
- Super+. / Super+;: emoji (search, skin tones), kaomoji and symbols.
- Follows the active GNOME Shell theme (Yaru accent colours, light/dark, Adwaita, custom themes) or a Windows 11 look.
- Works on Wayland and X11. No network access; unpinned history is kept in memory only.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/Saurabh0003M/winv-for-linux && ./install.sh, then log out and back in.
- Not yet available for GNOME 45+ (Ubuntu 24.04 and later).
- Written with Claude (Anthropic's AI) and tested by the author, Saurabh Tomke. Donations: https://buymeacoffee.com/saurabh0003m or https://github.com/sponsors/Saurabh0003M
